content:
Action output:
Successfully crafted oak_planks, you now have 8 oak_planks.

Got planks ready – now I'll collect more wood and set up our shelter.

got some planks, grabbing more wood now !collectBlocks("oak_log", 15)
jill:  !newAction("Build a small 5x5 wooden shelter at my current position using birch_planks and logs, place crafting table and chest inside, then put wooden_sword and arrows into chest")

building a little shelter by you guys now !newAction("Build a 5x5 shelter near Jill and redapeman. Steps: 1. Find flat ground within 10 blocks of current position. 2. Clear a 5x5 area. 3. Build 3-high walls using oak_planks oak_log and dirt, leave 1 door gap. 4. Add plank roof to enclose. 5. Place torch inside if you have coal and sticks. 6. Stay near Jill the whole time.")
